messages:
Mira (PM): FYI — Jordan just handed over an urgent sizing ask from OptiHealth. They want a proposal for dedicated capacity + burst for a pilot next month.
Jordan (Sales): OptiHealth expects ~800 qps steady during business hours, spiking to ~4k qps for 5–10m after daily reports. They care about 95th latency < 200ms for chat completions.
Priya (Solutions): Do we have their avg tokens per request and concurrency pattern? 800 qps could mean lots of concurrent sessions depending on latency and token length.
Jordan (Sales): Rough numbers from their engineering contact: avg 60 tokens per request, median response time target ~150ms, peaks are very bursty (a scheduled task fan-out).
Sam (SRE): Quick gut: 800 qps steady with 60 tokens -> ~48k tokens/s. With our typical gpt-style open model perf that maps to X GPUs for steady + Y GPUs for burst. Need perf profile for the model variant they want.
Eli (Infra Eng): We should propose 2 components: a reserved pool sized for steady-state throughput, and a short-lived burst pool with autoscale triggers and soft-preemption. Suggest reserved = capacity for 1k qps to give buffer, burst up to 5k qps with queueing timeout.
Mira (PM): Launch criteria for the pilot: 1) latency SLO hit rate >= 95% at 800 qps steady, 2) graceful degradation during 4k spikes (fallback to smaller model or rate-limit with informative error), 3) observability wired to console dashboards.
Priya (Solutions): For customer acceptance, include a runbook for the scheduled fan-out window: pre-warm the burst pool 10m before, set per-customer concurrency cap, and circuit-breaker to fallback to cached completions.
Sam (SRE): config sketch (for ops team):
```
reserved_pool: 
  target_qps: 1000
  min_gpus: 4
  max_gpus: 6
burst_policy:
  max_qps: 5000
  scale_up_window: 60s
  pre_warm: 600s
  cooldown: 300s
fallbacks:
  model_variant: small-quant
  rate_limit: 20rps_per_user
```
Jordan (Sales): Is the pre-warm 10 minutes realistic cost-wise? OptiHealth is price sensitive. Need a clear cost vs risk tradeoff in the proposal.
Eli (Infra Eng): We can offer an alternative: shorter pre-warm + predictive spin-up based on their scheduler webhook. If they can notify us T-2m, we can start limited burst ramp. That lowers cost but adds operational complexity.
Mira (PM): Action items: (1) Eli/Sam to produce two capacity recommendations (conservative w/10m pre-warm vs optimized webhook-driven) with estimated monthly cost deltas; (2) Priya to draft customer runbook and fallback UX; (3) Jordan to confirm model variant and token profile. Target: internal review in 48h.
capacity-bot: New sizing ticket created: #CAP-4289 assigned to Eli, Sam, Priya — due 2026-04-02.
Sam (SRE): I'll start with perf numbers for 13B and 70B opt-quant variants. Will include token/sec mapping and expected GPU counts.
Priya (Solutions): I'll mock the runbook and the dashboard widgets (token/s, queue depth, 95th latency) and drop screenshots.
Jordan (Sales): I'll get confirmation from OptiHealth on whether they can emit a pre-burst webhook. If yes, they'll prefer shorter pre-warm.
Mira (PM): Great. Keep thread updated. If any blockers on infra (e.g., new autoscale features), flag product weekly so we can negotiate scope with customer. :thumbsup:
